updates.label: Updates
updates.unavailable: This build does not update itself: it has no release key. Updates come with the next release from the project's page.
updates.system: Your system's updates bring new versions of Magnetite (dnf, apt or the software center). Magnetite offers a restart once one is installed.
updates.up_to_date: Magnetite is up to date. Last checked {when}.
updates.system_update: Magnetite {version} is available. Your system's updates install it.
updates.installing: Installing Magnetite {version}… Magnetite restarts when it is ready.
updates.auto_hint: At start and once a day Magnetite asks the project's release page on GitHub for a new version: no identifiers, no usage data. Before it installs an update, Magnetite checks it against the release manifest the project's key signed.

system_dialog.title: Magnetite {version} is available
system_dialog.centre: {centre} installs it with your system's other updates.
system_dialog.no_centre: Your system installs it with its other updates.
system_dialog.again: If it is not listed yet, let it look for updates again.
system_dialog.copy_failed: Could not copy the command. Select it and copy it by hand.
system_dialog.restart: Once it is installed, Magnetite offers a restart.
